head.kicker: World Trade Pro Weekly · Issue 4 · Week 43
head.title: Who's buying, who won, what moved
head.sub: 20 Oct – 26 Oct 2026 · 116 new projects in 57 countries (142 reports) · 34 tenders · 49 awards · 211 trade-flow signals

editor:
This week
EPC notices rose to 116 from 98 this week and tenders edged up to 34, while awards slipped to 49. One filer dominated the awards: China National Chemical Engineering (CNCEC) disclosed five contracts in a single filing, from a 300MW solar plant in Ghana to an FGL expansion in Algeria. The largest award was the US$403m Mechanical, Electrical and DSEAR Services contract in the UK. For bidders, the open work is in mid-sized European tenders, most of them closing in November, while CNCEC now has work committed on five jobs in three countries.

items.title: Strathcona Pitches 250,000-Bpd Oil Export Route to Asia
items.summary: Canadian oil producer Strathcona Resources wants to export up to 250,000 barrels per day of crude from British Columbia’s northern coast using rail…
items.html:
Oil, gas & LNG
Strathcona Pitches 250,000-Bpd Oil Export Route to Asia
oilprice.com · 3 reports this week
What it means: Strathcona wants to move up to 250,000 bpd of crude by rail to British Columbia's northern coast, which could give Asian buyers another Canadian supply option.

items.title: Panama Canal Traffic and Tonnage Rise Despite El Niño Challenges
items.summary: The Panama Canal reported growth in vessel traffic, tonnage and revenue in fiscal year 2026, as stronger demand from energy carriers and…
items.html:
Shipping, ports & logistics · Panama Canal
Panama Canal Traffic and Tonnage Rise Despite El Niño Challenges
gcaptain.com
What it means: Canal traffic, tonnage and revenue rose in fiscal 2026 on stronger demand from energy carriers, which shows shippers still relying on the route despite El Niño.

items.title: Saudi Crude Exports Hit Five-Month High as Production Falls to Record Low
items.summary: Saudi Arabia's crude exports rose about 7.9% in August from July to 4.451 million barrels per day, the highest since March, while its oil production…
items.html:
Oil, gas & LNG
Saudi Crude Exports Hit Five-Month High as Production Falls to Record Low
oilprice.com
What it means: Saudi crude exports rose about 7.9% in August to 4.451 million bpd while production fell to a record low, so buyers received more barrels despite lower output.

items.title: China: Port stocks build 2.85 million mt; Iron Ore Expected To Trade Soft
items.summary: The average imported iron ore margin widened slightly from 6.01 yuan/mt to 6.38 yuan/mt this period.
items.html:
Shipping, ports & logistics
China: Port stocks build 2.85 million mt; Iron Ore Expected To Trade Soft
hellenicshippingnews.com · 2 reports this week
What it means: Chinese port stocks built by 2.85 million mt and iron ore is expected to trade soft, which puts buyers in a stronger position when negotiating near-term cargoes.

items.title: China ramps up U.S. soybean purchases with 1.3M tons booked
items.summary: China has reportedly purchased nearly 48 million bushels of U.S. soybeans, boosting export demand following September trade talks.
items.html:
Agriculture & food
China ramps up U.S. soybean purchases with 1.3M tons booked
agdaily.com
What it means: China has booked about 1.3 million tons of US soybeans following September trade talks, so other buyers face more competition for US export cargoes.
